import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# 2. Transaction count by type
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
axes[1, 0].scatter(data['hour_of_day'], data['amount'], 
                   c=data['transaction_type'].astype('category').cat.codes, 
                   s=100, alpha=0.6, cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction distribution across hours
hour_data = data.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({'amount': 'sum', 'transaction_type': 'count'})
axes[1, 1].plot(hour_data.index, hour_data['amount'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#e41a1c')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Total Transaction Amount by Hour', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
